fields.label: Description
fields.options:
Alignment for the Payment Entry Cheque print format.

This section moves the WHOLE print on the paper. Use it when everything is off by the same amount — that is the printer gripping the paper differently, not a wrong measurement.

If only one item is wrong (the name is high, the amount is too far left), scroll down to Where each item is printed on the cheque and move just that item.

To try values without saving, add &dx=2.5&dy=-1 to the print URL. Those are added on top of the values here.

fields.description: Millimetres. Positive moves the print RIGHT, negative moves it LEFT.
fields.label: Move Right (mm)

fields.description: Millimetres. Positive moves the print DOWN, negative moves it UP.
fields.label: Move Down (mm)

fields.description: Flip to 270 if the text prints upside down on the cheque.
fields.label: Rotation

fields.description: How the printer grips a narrow sheet. The LBP2900 is centre-fed. Use Left only if your printer registers narrow paper against the left edge of the tray.
fields.label: Tray Alignment

fields.description: A4 = normal A4 page with the cheque placed where it sits in the tray (recommended, needs no custom paper size). Cheque = emit a true 88.9 x 190.5 mm page, only if that paper size is actually selected in the print dialog.
fields.label: Page Size
Where each item is printed on the cheque
Fields Description
fields.options:
These are the current positions, in millimetres measured on the cheque itself: From Left = distance from the cheque's left edge (the logo edge), From Top = distance from the cheque's top edge. They are the numbers the print format is using right now — change one and reprint to move just that item.

Use these when a single item sits wrong (payee too high, amount too far left). If everything is off by the same amount, do not touch these — use Move Right / Move Down above, which shifts the whole print.

Print with &cheque_guide=1 in the URL on a blank sheet to see the outline plus a printout of these values.

fields.description: mm from the cheque's LEFT edge to the first date box.
fields.label: Date - From Left (mm)

fields.description: mm from the cheque's TOP edge to the top of the digits.
fields.label: Date - From Top (mm)

fields.description: Extra space between date digits, so they land one per box. Increase if the digits drift LEFT of their boxes as you read right.
fields.label: Date - Digit Spacing (mm)

fields.description: mm from the cheque's LEFT edge to the start of the name.
fields.label: Name - From Left (mm)

fields.description: mm from the cheque's TOP edge to the top of the name.
fields.label: Name - From Top (mm)

fields.description: mm from the cheque's LEFT edge to the start of the words.
fields.label: Words - From Left (mm)

fields.description: mm from the cheque's TOP edge to the top of the FIRST line of words.
fields.label: Words - From Top (mm)

fields.description: How wide the words may run before wrapping to the second line.
fields.label: Words - Line Width (mm)

fields.description: Gap between the two printed word lines on the cheque.
fields.label: Words - Line Spacing (mm)

fields.description: mm from the cheque's LEFT edge to the start of the amount box.
fields.label: Amount - From Left (mm)

fields.description: mm from the cheque's TOP edge to the top of the amount.
fields.label: Amount - From Top (mm)

fields.description: Point size for all printed text. 11 is the tested value; raise only if the text looks small against the pre-printed lines.
fields.label: Font Size (pt)
